sources.note: Flatiron Health homepage. Describes company as reimagining cancer care infrastructure. Lists OncoEMR, Flatiron Assist, Clinical Pipe, and Trials products. Notes 275 oncology practices using their technology.

ONC certification/mandatory disclosures page. Lists OncoEMR v2.8 certified functionalities. Links to FHIR API docs, EHI export data dictionary, real world testing plans. Does NOT mention OneOncology HIE Integration.
OncoEMR product page. Heavy JavaScript rendering limited content extraction. Confirmed OncoEMR positioning as oncology EHR within Flatiron's Point of Care solutions.

Third-party review: 8.2/10 overall. Describes cloud-based oncology EHR with NCCN templates, AJCC staging, OncoAir mobile app, CareSpace portal. Pros: user-friendly, oncology-focused. Cons: integration difficulties, steep learning curve for advanced features.
Lists OncoEMR features: NCCN templates, AJCC staging, SureScripts e-prescribing, SeeMyChart patient portal, integration with RIS/labs/inventory/PM systems. Cloud-based, multi-platform.

Detailed feature list: oncology-specific workflows, 3000+ NCCN templates, AJCC staging, FDB drug info, OncoAir mobile app, CareSpace patient portal (health info, bill pay, messaging), Flatiron Insight dashboards, OncoTrials, e-prescribing. HIPAA/HITRUST/SOC2 compliant.

Lists OncoCloud Suite components: OncoEMR, OncoBilling (EDI/claims/remittance), OncoAnalytics (value-based care tracking), OncoTrials. 150+ pre-loaded reports. Ratings: 3.8/5 overall, 4.0 ease-of-use. Cons noted: high price.

OncoCloud platform press release. Describes OncoAnalytics with new Billing Insights module (one user recovered $400K underbilled charges). Platform supports 2000+ clinicians, nearly 1M active cancer patients.
2014 press release: Flatiron acquires Altos Solutions (creator of OncoEMR). At time of acquisition, OncoEMR had 1300+ clinicians, thousands of users, 550K unique cancer patients/year.
2018: Roche acquires Flatiron Health for $1.9B. Flatiron continues as separate legal entity.
KLAS 2019: OncoEMR rated #1 for Overall Satisfaction in Medical Oncology. Outperformed in 11 of 20 KPIs.
2025 KLAS coverage: Flatiron and Ontada frequently chosen by community oncology centers for oncology-specific design.
OneOncology launch announcement (2018). Founded by Tennessee Oncology, NY Cancer & Blood Specialists, West Cancer Center. 225+ providers, 60+ locations. Flatiron powering technology platform.
OneOncology annual report on technology. Uses Flatiron Assist, Genomic Lookback, ViTE trial matching, ProMPT. Clinical pathways for 25 diseases. Electronic regulatory binder and CTMS.
2023: TPG and AmerisourceBergen (Cencora) acquire OneOncology for $2.1B from General Atlantic. Network of 900+ providers, 250+ locations.
2025: Cencora accelerating full OneOncology acquisition. Enterprise valued at $7.4B. Network now ~1,750 providers across 565+ care sites.
Natera integration with OncoEMR for genomic test result delivery directly into the EHR.
KLAS listing for Flatiron OncoEMR (Mostly Ambulatory). Confirms ambulatory/community oncology positioning.
